name: handoff
description: Saves working notes before every compaction and offers them back after; near auto-compaction asks once: compact now or hand off to a fresh chat

threshold.title: Threshold (%)
threshold.description: Ask once (compact now, or hand off to a fresh chat) at this fill, 50 to 99; five points before auto-compaction instead when that comes sooner

summarize.title: Summarize with Haiku
summarize.description: Add a short 'where we are / next step' summary to each note: one Haiku call per handoff. Off: the note is built from the session alone, no tokens
